option.name: --brief
tip: Report only when files differ.

option.name: --changed-group-format
tip: Format changed input groups with GFMT.

option.name: --color
tip: Color output; WHEN is never, always or auto.
Plain --color means --color=auto.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --context
tip: Output NUM lines of copied context. (default 3)
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --ed
tip: Output an ed script.

option.name: --exclude
tip: Exclude files that match PAT.

option.name: --exclude-from
tip: Exclude files that match any pattern in FILE.

option.name: --expand-tabs
tip: Expand tabs to spaces in output.

option.name: --from-file
tip: Compare FILE1 to all operands; FILE1 can be a directory.

option.name: --help
tip: Display this help and exit.

option.name: --horizon-lines
tip: Keep NUM lines of the common prefix and suffix.

option.name: --ifdef
tip: Output a merged file with '#ifdef NAME' diffs.

option.name: --ignore-all-space
tip: Ignore all white space.

option.name: --ignore-blank-lines
tip: Ignore changes where lines are all blank.

option.name: --ignore-case
tip: Ignore case differences in file contents.

option.name: --ignore-file-name-case
tip: Ignore case when comparing file names.

option.name: --ignore-matching-lines
tip: Ignore changes where all lines match RE.

option.name: --ignore-space-change
tip: Ignore changes in the amount of white space.

option.name: --ignore-tab-expansion
tip: Ignore changes due to tab expansion.

option.name: --ignore-trailing-space
tip: Ignore white space at line end.

option.name: --initial-tab
tip: Make tabs line up by prepending a tab.

option.name: --label
tip: Use LABEL instead of file name and timestamp.
Can be repeated.

option.name: --left-column
tip: Output only the left column of common lines.

option.name: --line-format
tip: Format all input lines with LFMT.

option.name: --minimal
tip: Try hard to find a smaller set of changes.

option.name: --new-file
tip: Treat absent files as empty.

option.name: --new-group-format
tip: Format new input groups with GFMT.

option.name: --new-line-format
tip: Format new input lines with LFMT.

option.name: --no-dereference
tip: Do not follow symbolic links.

option.name: --no-ignore-file-name-case
tip: Consider case when comparing file names.

option.name: --normal
tip: Output a normal diff (the default).

option.name: --old-group-format
tip: Format old input groups with GFMT.

option.name: --old-line-format
tip: Format old input lines with LFMT.

option.name: --paginate
tip: Pass output through 'pr' to paginate it.

option.name: --palette
tip: Set the colors used when --color is active.
PALETTE is a colon-separated list of terminfo capabilities.

option.name: --rcs
tip: Output an RCS format diff.

option.name: --recursive
tip: Recursively compare any subdirectories found.

option.name: --report-identical-files
tip: Report when two files are the same.

option.name: --show-c-function
tip: Show which C function each change is in.

option.name: --show-function-line
tip: Show the most recent line matching RE.

option.name: --side-by-side
tip: Output in two columns.

option.name: --speed-large-files
tip: Assume large files and many scattered small changes.

option.name: --starting-file
tip: Start with FILE when comparing directories.

option.name: --strip-trailing-cr
tip: Strip trailing carriage return on input.

option.name: --suppress-blank-empty
tip: Suppress space or tab before empty output lines.

option.name: --suppress-common-lines
tip: Do not output common lines.

option.name: --tabsize
tip: Use tab stops every NUM print columns. (default 8)

option.name: --text
tip: Treat all files as text.

option.name: --to-file
tip: Compare all operands to FILE2; FILE2 can be a directory.

option.name: --unchanged-group-format
tip: Format unchanged input groups with GFMT.

option.name: --unchanged-line-format
tip: Format unchanged input lines with LFMT.

option.name: --unidirectional-new-file
tip: Treat absent first files as empty.

option.name: --unified
tip: Output NUM lines of unified context. (default 3)
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --version
tip: Output version information and exit.

option.name: --width
tip: Output at most NUM print columns. (default 130)

option.name: -c
tip: Output a context diff with three lines of context.

option.name: -C
tip: Output NUM lines of copied context.

option.name: -u
tip: Output a unified diff with three lines of context.

option.name: -U
tip: Output NUM lines of unified context.
